title: Google Pixel 9 Pro
shortDescription: Google AI, a stunning camera, and an all-day battery.
description: Pixel 9 Pro brings the best of Google AI to your pocket with the Tensor G4 chip, a pro-grade triple camera, and Gemini built in.

title: OnePlus 12
shortDescription: Pro-grade Hasselblad cameras with a blazing 120Hz display.
description: The OnePlus 12 pairs the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 with a 2K 120Hz ProXDR display and a Hasselblad-tuned camera system.

title: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14
shortDescription: A powerful gaming laptop in an ultra-portable chassis.
description: Zephyrus G14 packs an AMD Ryzen 9 and RTX 4060 into a 14-inch magnesium-alloy body with a 165Hz OLED display.

title: Dell XPS 15
shortDescription: A creator-focused laptop with an InfinityEdge OLED display.
description: The XPS 15 combines a stunning OLED touch display with Intel Core Ultra processing and NVIDIA graphics for creators.

title: Sony WF-1000XM5 Earbuds
shortDescription: Best-in-class noise cancelling earbuds in a tiny design.
description: WF-1000XM5 wireless earbuds deliver the ultimate listening experience with industry-leading ANC and a 30% smaller design.

title: Apple AirPods Pro 2
shortDescription: Up to 2x more Active Noise Cancellation with Adaptive Audio.
description: AirPods Pro 2 feature Adaptive Audio, Personalized Spatial Audio, and up to 6 hours of listening on a single charge.

title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S9
shortDescription: A flagship tablet built for entertainment and creativity.
description: The Galaxy Tab S9 features an AMOLED display, Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, and an included S Pen for a premium tablet experience.

title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 6
shortDescription: Advanced health tracking in a sleek circular design.
description: Galaxy Watch 6 tracks sleep, body composition, and heart health with a brighter Always-On display and improved fitness features.

title: Logitech G502 X Plus
shortDescription: A wireless gaming mouse with LIGHTSPEED and RGB.
description: G502 X Plus combines LIGHTFORCE hybrid switches, the HERO 25K sensor, and LIGHTSYNC RGB for esports-grade performance.

title: Razer BlackWidow V4
shortDescription: A mechanical keyboard with hot-swap switches and RGB.
description: BlackWidow V4 features Razer mechanical switches, a magnetic plush wrist rest, and vibrant Chroma RGB.

title: PlayStation 5 Slim
shortDescription: Lightning-fast loading with an expansive SSD.
description: Experience the PlayStation 5 with 4K gaming, ray tracing, haptic feedback, and a compact new design with 1TB SSD.

title: Xbox Series X
shortDescription: The most powerful Xbox with 12 teraflops of power.
description: Xbox Series X delivers true 4K gaming, up to 120fps, and lightning-fast load times with Quick Resume.

title: Samsung Odyssey G9
description: Odyssey G9 offers a massive 49-inch Dual QHD curved display with a 240Hz refresh rate and 1ms response for immersive gaming.

title: DJI Air 3
shortDescription: Dual cameras and 46 minutes of flight in one drone.
description: DJI Air 3 features a dual-primary-camera system, 46-minute max flight time, and omnidirectional obstacle sensing.

title: Roku Streaming Stick 4K
shortDescription: The easiest way to stream 4K content in seconds.
description: Stream 4K, HDR10+, and Dolby Vision content from thousands of channels with the powerful Roku Streaming Stick 4K.

title: Anker PowerCore 26800
description: Keep your devices charged all day with 26,800mAh capacity, 3 USB ports, and high-speed charging for phones and tablets.
